title: Quantifying Concentration Phenomena of Mean-Field Transformers in the Low-Temperature Regime
summary: Transformers with self-attention modules as their core components have become an integral architecture in modern large language and foundation models. In this paper, we study the evolution of tokens in deep encoder-only transformers at inference time which is described in the large-token limit by a mean-field continuity equation.
